response.overview: This film follows a petty thief and Jayden (From the boiling frog) as a strange chain of events drags them both back into the room - now transformed into something even more barren, uncanny, and wrong. With nothing but a packet of olives to share, they drift through days of nonsense rituals, fragmented conversations, and desperate attempts to keep their sanity from cracking. The film's eerie atmosphere comes from the way the room itself feels alive, subtly shifting as their minds unravel, turning this bizarre two-man standoff into a study of mental strain and absurd survival.
response.tagline: HAVE YOU BEEN IN A PLACE LIKE THIS BEFORE?
response.title: Olive
